dict.string: MAXplorer needs access to your Desktop to browse and manage files.
MAXplorer needs access to your Documents folder to browse and manage files.
MAXplorer needs access to your Downloads folder to browse and manage files.
MAXplorer needs access to removable volumes to browse and manage files.
MAXplorer needs access to network volumes to browse and manage files.
MAXplorer. Independent file manager for macOS. Not affiliated with Microsoft or Apple.
